temperature.implementation: hand-authored base profile and Gaussian spatial terms multiplied by synthetic cycle phase

hydration.implementation: hand-authored vertical profile and phase-shaped drying term

h2_concentration.implementation: formula involving a synthetic radiation-zone factor and water-presence factor; no absorbed-dose closure

u235_ratio.implementation: present-day-like base ratio with smooth spatial decrement; no historical isotope inventory or depletion solver

polymer_yield.implementation: clay/fracture weights multiplied by a sinusoidal phase factor; not a kinetic rate or experimentally calibrated concentration

compartments.implementation: spatial threshold classification; original palette path collapses nonzero categories

known_limitations: No neutron transport or k-effective/eigenvalue calculation is implemented by the prototype field formulas.

No coupled heat PDE, multiphase flow, fracture-flow, reactive transport, radiolysis dose calculation, Bateman depletion network, or polymerization kinetics is implemented by the prototype field formulas.
Carbon mass closure is algebraically defined and is not an independent reaction-network conservation test.
The categorical colormap clamps category inputs before label lookup.
The uranium isotope field conflates present-day-style abundance with a historical scenario and is not depletion output.
The H2 concentration field has no dimensionally complete absorbed-energy-to-concentration calculation.
MRC output requires independent format and scale/axis validation.
Tailwind is loaded from an external CDN, so offline behavior is not guaranteed.

separation_contract.historical_oklo_evidence: separate sourced records, not generated by this fixture
